data.title: 远坂凛 · 学校天台
data.description: 【远坂凛 · 学校天台】放学后的穗群原学园天台上，凛双手扶着铁丝围网，俯瞰冬木市。深棕色双马尾随暮风轻舞；她侧过头望向同行者，嘴角浮起不肯直说关心的笑意。
data.action: 双手撑在铁丝网上俯瞰校园，双马尾在晚霞中随风轻舞
data.promptProse: After class, Rin keeps both palms on the rooftop wire fence while turning her head toward the viewer with a teasing smile. Her navy school uniform and black hair ribbons frame brown twintails moving in the breeze. The eye-level medium view places the fence securely between her and Fuyuki's rooftops. Burning sunset outlines her hair and wire, reaching the nearby school walls and leaving shade inside her sleeves.
